messages:
alex: quick q — changed default batch_size from 8 -> 16 to improve throughput. no API signature changes. do we treat this as a patch bump or a minor? planning to release in today's change window.
mira: patch if it's purely perf and not changing externally-observed behavior. but if outputs can differ (ordering/timing) call it minor and call it out.
chen: this can affect determinism for some customers. semver-wise i'd lean minor when defaults change output characteristics. also: tagging convention question — we should standardize buildmeta vs suffix.
tess: ops note: our deploy tooling struggles with `+` in tags in some registries. current safe pattern is hyphen suffixes like `-patch.N` or `-hotfix.N`. keeps CI simple.
alex: two camps then. what about rollback criteria? propose canary 10% traffic for 30m, metrics: p95 latency +10% or errors +0.5% -> rollback immediately.
mira: agree. release notes must explicitly say "default changed" and how to opt out (env/config), and mention expected perf delta.
chen: pragmatic proposal: treat this as a patch bump (increment patch), but use a hyphenated internal suffix so deploy tools are happy. e.g.
```
# tag example
v1.7.3-patch.46  # internal deploy id
v1.7.3+ci.46     # canonical semver+buildmeta (not used by deploy tooling)
```
That way main semver stays correct and tooling can parse the suffix.
deploy-bot: created release candidate `v1.7.3-patch.46` for channel `canary` by @alex. To promote run: `/deploy promote v1.7.3-patch.46`.
tess: i'll kick off canary at 14:10 UTC inside today's 2h change window. threshold alerts wired to telemetry playbook.
alex: tagging decision acknowledged — i'll add CHANGELOG entry and short opt-out snippet:
```
Defaults: batch_size from 8 -> 16
Opt-out: set REDWOOD_BATCH_SIZE=<value> or override in config
Impact: throughput up, latency distribution may shift (see perf dashboard)
```
mira: :thumbsup: also add a one-liner in release notes under COMPATIBILITY so customers relying on defaults see it.
chen: after canary, if nontrivial diffs in evals we should consider a minor release for transparency, but let's run with patch+suffix for now.
alex: sounds good — proceeding with `v1.7.3-patch.46` canary. will post followup with promote/rollback decision
